title: Canyon Runner
description: Race along rugged canyon rims! Leap over rocks and ravines, collect gems, and discover breathtaking vistas. Speed increases over time.
detailedDescription: Sprint across sweeping canyon landscapes in this endless runner with a vertical twist. Your character automatically runs forward — time your jumps to clear chasms, slide under low overhangs, and double-jump to reach elevated gem clusters. The terrain generates procedurally with distinct biomes: red rock mesas, emerald forests, frozen peaks, and volcanic badlands. Each biome introduces unique obstacles and visual flair. Collect gems to unlock new characters and visual themes. The speed gradually increases, pushing your reflexes to the limit.
controls: Spacebar or tap to jump. Press again in mid-air for a double-jump. Down arrow or swipe down to slide. Collect gems for points. Run as far as you can — speed increases over time.
